pages.text: The management panel is your master console for town interaction.
Press the $(bold)V key$() (configurable in controls) to enter the top-down view and open the console.
pages.title: How to Open

pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Target Focus$(): Hover over any mage or building to see a white bounding box. $(bold)Right-click$() to open their detail screen.$(li)$(bold)Sub-mode Keys$(): Press number keys 1-4:$(li)$(bold)1 -> Building Mode$(): Select, rotate, and place buildings.$(li)$(bold)2 -> Road Mode$(): Level ground and pave paths.$(li)$(bold)3 -> Task Hall$(): Inspect ongoing jobs and mage tasks.$(li)$(bold)4 -> Settings$(): Configure mod options.
pages.title: Basic Operations
